projects.title: VLRCards
projects.description: FIFA-style rating system and player database for VALORANT using VCT data from vlr.gg. Features a Python ETL pipeline with scraping, SQLite database, FastAPI backend, and a modern Next.js frontend.
projects.summary: FIFA-style rating system and player database for VALORANT, built on VCT data from vlr.gg with a Python ETL pipeline, FastAPI and Next.js.

projects.title: Saldito
projects.description: Built a mobile-first personal finance application using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Astro, and TypeScript to manage accounts, transactions, budgets, and savings goals. Designed relational data models for accounts, credit cards, installment purchases, recurring payments, transfers, and financial reports. Implemented cash-flow forecasting, CSV import/export, receipt uploads, and spending analytics.
projects.summary: Mobile-first personal finance app for accounts, budgets and savings goals, with cash-flow forecasting and spending analytics.

projects.title: PSell Kitchen Dashboard
projects.description: Designed a real-time, bidirectional sync architecture using Supabase Realtime and PowerSync, keeping order state consistent across web and mobile clients with sub-second latency. Built a Kanban-style kitchen operations dashboard app and webapp with automated visual alerts and time-based status tracking.
projects.summary: Kanban-style kitchen operations with real-time, bidirectional sync across web and mobile clients.

projects.title: Secure Distributed Banking Ledger
projects.description: Architected a secure RESTful API for financial transaction processing, implementing JWT Authentication to safeguard user data and prevent unauthorized access.
projects.summary: A secure REST API for financial transactions with JWT authentication.

projects.title: Enterprise Event Management System
projects.description: Led backend development for a team, designing normalized SQL Server database schemas to manage complex event data. Built and deployed CRUD API endpoints on Azure, facilitating seamless event creation and management.
projects.summary: Normalized SQL Server schemas and CRUD API endpoints deployed on Azure.
